title: USE SRD HUD MAKER without playtest

posts.author: ebwoennedayou
posts.body:
hi i recently update my rpgmv in steam and suddenly the playtest wont work i tried everything,literally everything.
so i wanna use plugin by srd called hud maker, and it requires a playtest,
anyone have an idea? or maybhe alternative?
i just wanna show the player
hp on screen thats all

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
What happens if you try to playtest?
you should always fix errors, not work around them - especially if they are things you might need later.
most likely you had updated nw.js previously and the MV update downgraded it to a version that is now incompatible to the playtest engine, but only with the error message or something similar we can tell if it is this case or one of the few other cases.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body: If you don't get an error message, that usually means that either the exe in the project folder is deleted or damaged (then simply copy it from a new project) or that a third party background progeam (like network security or antivirus) blocks the access (in which case you need to check all logs until you find the responsible program and whitelist the maker there).

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
ebwoennedayou said:
exe ? but when i make a project there is no exe in it?
Click to expand...
No, that's correct, RPG Maker MV and MZ do not have an executable in the project folder. The playtest is run by the editor.
I think your most likely candidate is that it's being blocked by anti-virus as Andar suggested. If you disable Windows Defender and any other anti-malware programs that are running, does the playtest work?

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
1.6.1 works on my end as well for 1.6.2
it's most likely it wont play test (as I had it one) is because something was running
in the taskManager, stop that and it should work as normal again afterwards.
its mostly like the nwJS still running as seeing it as playTest that is running still.
but if you only want the HP to show on screen, and nothing more, than I wont
recommend SRD_HUDMaker for it.
as there are some simplify plugin like galv_variableBar to show a bar,
bound it to an actorHP and your done.
a simple function can also accomplish this as I have a test plugin for bars on map.
so simply attach actor HP should do the think.
if it has more elements to than I would use it or overhaul in battle as well.
not just for a simple HP status though.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
But did you try changing your nwjs as Andar had mention?
Considering how often we have had similar reports - especially when relating to the update - it seems highly likely that it's the nwjs problem.
